aesthetics: 1990s anime cel animation, Akira Toriyama Dragon Ball character style with the muted cinematic restraint of a 1990s anime film still, fine photographic film grain across the whole frame, one warm palette of ochre, cream, weathered grey and deep indigo shadow
lighting: warm lamp light from above, soft falloff into deep shadow at the edges of the room, a gentle rim light on the figure
medium: hand-painted 1990s anime cel, opaque gouache background, inked outlines with the slight print softness of an old animation still, fine even film grain
art_style: 1990s cel-anime illustration in the style of Akira Toriyama, rounded exaggerated Dragon Ball proportions, flat cel paint with hand-painted gradients, fine all-over film grain, one restrained palette
